implementation.rule: Keep original directional-span samples unchanged. When consecutive selected cells are not8neighbours, traverse only the intervening original UV-ordered piecewise curve across grid boundaries. The resulting ordered corridor supplies candidate cells. implementation.responsibility: The same source authoring path selects cells and obtains original triangle/barycentric/world/UV/depth packets. It is not a downstream mask repair or raster-neighbour dilation.

implementation.explicitFailure: A selected cell without an original triangle packet now yields unsupported/fallback instead of partial ready. Captured fallback remains failure. No depth tolerance, visibility policy, palette, eye, outline, material, camera or shader change.

inputConditions: Finite projected coordinates in the supported integer grid; current head grid is480x272.
An ordered continuous piecewise curve from the paired UV ribbon, with monotone directional spans accepted by the existing source sampler.
Every selected cell must have a valid original surface packet; unsupported geometry is reported as failure.
guarantee.whyConnected: Grid traversal visits an8-connected chain along each actual source segment; shared curve vertices join those chains. Thus the ordered candidate graph always contains the consecutive-corridor path. Dynamic programming only chooses8-neighbour edges, so its selected path remains connected. Existing connected edges and the two true endpoint cells are preserved.
guarantee.scopeOfGuarantee: Raw source-cell path before physical occlusion and viewport clipping. It does not force connection through occluders, join another strand, guarantee all negative-space topology, or solve global temporal staircase quality. Non-monotone spans and invalid/missing source packets still fail explicitly.
